summary: Full backend (9/9 pytest) and frontend (Playwright E2E) testing of XOK'S single-product e-commerce. Home -> product showcase -> add to cart -> cart sheet -> checkout -> order success -> admin all working. Order XOKS-1003 was created and admin lists all 3 orders with functional status selects.

issues: React a11y warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent. Add SheetDescription for a11y compliance.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid attributes at the section-level: hero, value-proposition, product-showcase, social-proof - currently missing though sub-elements have testids and work.
(Optional) Add SheetDescription/aria-describedby to CartSheet DialogContent to remove React a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Order number generation uses count_documents+1000 which is race-prone under concurrency; consider atomic counter/collection sequence.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec; browsers ignore credentials in this case. Fine since guest checkout has no cookies.
PATCH /orders does not validate status value against allowed enum (pending/shipped/delivered/cancelled). Any string is accepted.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test orders via API/UI with TEST_ prefixed names (XOKS-1002, XOKS-1003)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 backend pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py pass. Frontend E2E flow (add-to-cart -> checkout -> success -> admin) verified visually. Product seeded with id 'xoks-pro-elite' at 49.99 EUR, sizes S/M/L/XL. Order numbers increment from XOKS-1001.
